raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

On ROCm, GLM-5.3-Flash with a DFlash2 drafter fails at startup. The model's indexer needs the BLHNC KV cache layout, but `ROCM_ATTN`, the drafter's backend, declares only LHBNC and LBHNC. This PR lets `ROCM_ATTN` declare BLHNC too.

Related:
- #61761: DFlash2 performance on ROCm.
- #61433 (draft, paused until the aiter pin bump) ranks `ROCM_ATTN` below the unified backends for spec decode, so auto-selection would stop picking it for the drafter. Until then, main auto-selects `ROCM_ATTN` for the drafter and fails at startup. An explicit `"attention_backend": "ROCM_ATTN"` fails in both cases. The two PRs do not depend on each other.

## Claims

- `amd/GLM-5.3-Flash-Quark-MXFP4` with `incoai/GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2` starts and serves on ROCm. On main, startup fails with:
  ```
  ValueError: No KV cache layout satisfies every supported set: [['BLHNC'], ['LBNHC', 'LBHNC', 'BLHNC'], ['LHBNC', 'LBHNC']].
  ```
- `ROCM_ATTN` gives correct output in every layout it declares, BLHNC included. It is checked against SDPA by a new test.

## Validation

**Startup and serving.** MI355X, TP2, breakable CUDA graphs with `max_cudagraph_capture_size` 2048. Output tok/s (acceptance length):

| drafter backend | c=1 | c=16 | c=64 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TRITON_ATTN` (workaround on main) | 398.8 (4.62) | 2135.5 (4.40) | 4608.1 (4.63) |
| `ROCM_ATTN` (this PR) | 412.9 (4.85) | 2238.5 (4.74) | 4400.6 (4.51) |

- This PR is about starting, not speed. In step time (TPOT × acceptance length), `ROCM_ATTN` is about 2% slower at c=64 (60.2 vs 58.9 ms). That agrees with #61433.
- GSM8K with the `ROCM_ATTN` drafter is 0.9704. That run also had the KDA patches from #63071 and #63072 applied.

**Test.** `tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_attn_kv_cache_layouts.py`: 24 passed on MI355X.
- The cases are every declared layout × block size 16/128 × causal/non-causal (DFlash) × bf16/fp8 cache. Each runs the backend's own cache writer and attention, and compares the output to SDPA.
- On main the test does not fail; it just has no BLHNC cases, because it is parametrized over the layouts the backend declares. The startup error above is the reproducer.
- To check that the test can catch errors, I flipped causality and zeroed one cache block. All 24 cases failed.

<details>
<summary>Setup and commands</summary>

One MI355X node (gfx950). TP2. Image `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100-e68efc685a`, with the patches named in each row applied on top. `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`.

```bash
vllm serve amd/GLM-5.3-Flash-Quark-MXFP4 -tp 2 --max-model-len 16384 --max-num-seqs 256 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image": 0, "video": 0}' \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  [--compilation-config '{"max_cudagraph_capture_size": 2048}'] \
  --speculative-config '{"method": "dflash", "model": "incoai/GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2", "num_speculative_tokens": 7}'
vllm bench serve --dataset-name sharegpt --sharegpt-output-len 512 --temperature 0 --seed 0 \
  --num-prompts max(64, 8*C) --max-concurrency C
```

- Acceptance length comes from the `vllm:spec_decode_*` counters, read before and after each concurrency.
- GSM8K uses all 1319 test questions: zero-shot chat, greedy, thinking on, up to 6144 output tokens, concurrency 64. The score is the last number after `</think>`.
- Each row is one run. Acceptance length varies by about ±0.15 between runs, so the step time is given as TPOT × acceptance length, which is one spec step.

</details>

## Details

**Root cause.** Since #57169 the GLM-5.3-Flash indexer requires the block-outermost BLHNC layout. The worker intersects the layouts of all attention groups. With a DFlash2 drafter on `ROCM_ATTN`, the intersection is empty.

**Why BLHNC is safe for `ROCM_ATTN`.** BLHNC differs from the LBHNC layout, which is already supported, only in the block stride.
- The Triton fallbacks (`context_attention_fwd`, `kernel_paged_attention_2d`) take every cache stride from the tensor.
- The native HIP kernels stay gated on `has_native_kv_cache_layout`, which needs a packed block stride. So BLHNC always runs the Triton path.

**Test design.** The shared backend harness lays the cache out per KV head. `ROCM_ATTN` binds K and V as two head groups, so the new test drives the backend's own writer and attention on a per-layer view in each layout.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

detail.title: [Bugfix][ROCm] Let ROCM_ATTN share the BLHNC KV cache layout

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,161 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""ROCM_ATTN in every KV cache layout it declares.
+
+The shared backend harness lays the cache out as [B, num_kv_heads, N, 2 * hs],
+while ROCM_ATTN binds [B, 2, N, num_kv_heads * hs] (K and V as two head
+groups), so this drives the backend's own cache writer and attention on a
+per-layer view in each layout and checks them against SDPA.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+    pytest.skip("ROCM_ATTN is ROCm-only", allow_module_level=True)
+
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_attn import (  # noqa: E402
+    RocmAttentionBackend,
+    RocmAttentionImpl,
+    RocmAttentionMetadata,
+)
+
+NUM_HEADS, NUM_KV_HEADS, HEAD_SIZE = 16, 4, 128
+NUM_BLOCKS = 64
+# (context_len, query_len) per sequence: decodes, a DFlash-style 8-token
+# query and a prefill.
+SEQS = [(37, 1), (0, 8), (100, 8), (21, 1), (0, 45)]
+
+
+class _Layer:
+    def __init__(self, device):
+        self._q_scale = torch.ones(1, device=device)
+        self._k_scale = torch.ones(1, device=device)
+        self._v_scale = torch.ones(1, device=device)
+        self._q_scale_float = self._k_scale_float = self._v_scale_float = 1.0
+
+
+def _kv_cache_view(layout, block_size, dtype, device):
+    """The per-layer [B, 2, N, H * hs] view bound to the layer under layout.
+
+    Layouts with the layer inside the block get two layers, so the view keeps
+    the gaps between one layer's blocks."""
+    logical = (
+        1 if layout.is_layer_compact else 2,
+        NUM_BLOCKS,
+        2,
+        block_size,
+        NUM_KV_HEADS * HEAD_SIZE,
+    )
+    physical = torch.zeros(
+        [logical[i] for i in layout.stride_order], dtype=dtype, device=device
+    )
+    return physical.permute(*[layout.stride_order.index(i) for i in range(5)])[0]
+
+
+def _reference(q, k, v, causal):
+    out = []
+    for i, (ctx, qlen) in enumerate(SEQS):
+        qi = q[i].transpose(0, 1)
+        ki = k[i].repeat_interleave(NUM_HEADS // NUM_KV_HEADS, 1).transpose(0, 1)
+        vi = v[i].repeat_interleave(NUM_HEADS // NUM_KV_HEADS, 1).transpose(0, 1)
+        mask = None
+        if causal:
+            mask = torch.ones(qlen, ctx + qlen, dtype=torch.bool, device=q[i].device)
+            mask = mask.tril(ctx)
+        o = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
+            qi.float(), ki.float(), vi.float(), attn_mask=mask, scale=HEAD_SIZE**-0.5
+        )
+        out.append(o.transpose(0, 1))
+    return torch.cat(out)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "layout", RocmAttentionBackend.supported_kv_cache_layouts(), ids=lambda x: x.name
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("block_size", [16, 128])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("causal", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kv_cache_dtype", ["auto", "fp8"])
+def test_rocm_attn_kv_cache_layouts(layout, block_size, causal, kv_cache_dtype):
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    device = torch.device("cuda")
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    fp8 = kv_cache_dtype == "fp8"
+    layer = _Layer(device)
+    impl = RocmAttentionImpl(
+        NUM_HEADS,
+        HEAD_SIZE,
+        HEAD_SIZE**-0.5,
+        NUM_KV_HEADS,
+        alibi_slopes=None,
+        sliding_window=None,
+        kv_cache_dtype=kv_cache_dtype,
+    )
+    kv_cache = _kv_cache_view(layout, block_size, torch.uint8 if fp8 else dtype, device)
+
+    q = [
+        torch.randn(qlen, NUM_HEADS, HEAD_SIZE, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+        for _, qlen in SEQS
+    ]
+    k = [
+        torch.randn(ctx + qlen, NUM_KV_HEADS, HEAD_SIZE, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+        for ctx, qlen in SEQS
+    ]
+    v = [torch.randn_like(x) for x in k]
+    if fp8:
+        # The reference sees the values the cache stores.
+        fp8_dtype = current_platform.fp8_dtype()
+        k = [x.to(fp8_dtype).to(dtype) for x in k]
+        v = [x.to(fp8_dtype).to(dtype) for x in v]
+
+    # Scattered blocks; block 0 is the null block.
+    perm = (torch.randperm(NUM_BLOCKS - 1) + 1).tolist()
+    max_blocks = max((c + n + block_size - 1) // block_size for c, n in SEQS)
+    block_table = torch.zeros(len(SEQS), max_blocks, dtype=torch.int32)
+    for i, (ctx, qlen) in enumerate(SEQS):
+        n = (ctx + qlen + block_size - 1) // block_size
+        block_table[i, :n] = torch.tensor([perm.pop() for _ in range(n)])
+
+    def slots(i, start, end):
+        pos = torch.arange(start, end)
+        return block_table[i, pos // block_size].long() * block_size + pos % block_size
+
+    # Write the context with the backend's own writer, as earlier steps would.
+    ctx_slots = torch.cat([slots(i, 0, c) for i, (c, _) in enumerate(SEQS)])
+    impl.do_kv_cache_update(
+        layer,
+        torch.cat([x[:c] for x, (c, _) in zip(k, SEQS)]),
+        torch.cat([x[:c] for x, (c, _) in zip(v, SEQS)]),
+        kv_cache,
+        ctx_slots.to(device),
+    )
+
+    new_k = torch.cat([x[c:] for x, (c, _) in zip(k, SEQS)])
+    new_v = torch.cat([x[c:] for x, (c, _) in zip(v, SEQS)])
+    new_slots = torch.cat([slots(i, c, c + n) for i, (c, n) in enumerate(SEQS)])
+    impl.do_kv_cache_update(layer, new_k, new_v, kv_cache, new_slots.to(device))
+
+    query_lens = torch.tensor([n for _, n in SEQS], dtype=torch.int32)
+    seq_lens = torch.tensor([c + n for c, n in SEQS], dtype=torch.int32)
+    query_start_loc = torch.zeros(len(SEQS) + 1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    query_start_loc[1:] = query_lens.cumsum(0)
+    metadata = RocmAttentionMetadata(
+        num_actual_tokens=int(query_lens.sum()),
+        max_query_len=int(query_lens.max()),
+        query_start_loc=query_start_loc.to(device),
+        max_seq_len=int(seq_lens.max()),
+        seq_lens=seq_lens.to(device),
+        block_table=block_table.to(device),
+        slot_mapping=new_slots.to(device),
+        causal=causal,
+    )
+    query = torch.cat(q)
+    output = torch.empty_like(query)
+    impl.forward(layer, query, new_k, new_v, kv_cache, metadata, output)
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        output.float(), _reference(q, k, v, causal), atol=2e-2, rtol=2e-2
+    )

@@ -237,8 +237,11 @@ def supported_kv_cache_layouts(cls) -> tuple[KVCacheLayout, ...]:
         # The native HIP kernels hardcode group-contiguous block addressing, so
         # they need the K and V groups to span all blocks (H outermost within the layer)
         # The Triton fallbacks are stride-aware, so block-interior LBHNC is also
-        # supported, just without the native kernels.
-        return (KVCacheLayout.LHBNC, KVCacheLayout.LBHNC)
+        # supported, just without the native kernels. So is block-outermost
+        # BLHNC, which only widens the block stride; models whose other
+        # backends require it (e.g. the GLM-5.3-Flash indexer, with a DFlash2
+        # drafter on this backend) need it.
+        return (KVCacheLayout.LHBNC, KVCacheLayout.LBHNC, KVCacheLayout.BLHNC)
 
     @staticmethod
     def get_builder_cls() -> type["RocmAttentionMetadataBuilder"]:
